# spyro ps

List processes on remote server.

## Before you run it

Uses a plain `ssh` (no keychain password injection): needs key/agent auth or a live ControlMaster.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro ps`

```text
Usage: spyro ps [OPTIONS]

  List processes on remote server.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name (auto-detects if only one exists)
  -g, --grep TEXT     Filter processes (grep pattern)
  --json              Output as JSON
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```
